title: Compact pattern posting: opt-in G52 local coordinate shift and M98/M99 subprograms for verified posts

body:
## Goal

Add an opt-in compact post output mode for linear and grid pattern folders that uses local coordinate shifts (`G52`) and subprograms (`M98`/`M99` or dialect equivalent) on verified posts to reduce program size for high-count plate jobs. Depends on the pattern folder sub-issue of `#2938`.

## Scope

- **Output mode (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`, commands, MCP, project file):** Add an optional `PatternPostMode` setting on `PatternDef` with `Expanded` (default), `LocalShift` (`G52`), and `Subprogram` (`G52` + subprogram calls). Keep `Expanded` as the default so existing goldens do not change.
- **Post manifest capabilities (`assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, `crates/post/src/`):**
  - Add explicit opt-in manifest flags (`localShift = true`, `subprograms = true`) and CNC intermediate records or hooks for local shifts and subprogram calls.
  - Refuse by name any post script that does not declare the requested capability (matching `wcsRotation` and `axisInversion` refusal laws).
  - Refuse `LocalShift` or `Subprogram` for mirror folders and rotary circular patterns (a `G52` shift translates only and cannot mirror or index a rotary axis).
- **Verified dialects (`assets/posts/*.cps`):**
  - Implement and cite public control manuals (RS-274 / ISO 6983, Fanuc, Haas, LinuxCNC) for the first verified set: `fanuc.cps`, `haas.cps`, `doosan-dnm.cps`, `mazak.cps`, `mach4.cps` (`G52` + `M98`/`M99`), and `tormach.cps` (`G52` + LinuxCNC `O<sub> call`).
  - Always cancel local shift (`G52 X0. Y0. Z0.`) before every tool change, after the pattern, and at program end.

## Done means

Golden NC tests and a coordinate-interpreter verification test prove that `LocalShift` and `Subprogram` output cuts the exact same world coordinates as `Expanded` moves, cancels `G52 X0. Y0. Z0.` before tool changes and program end, and refuses undeclared posts and mirror/rotary folders by name.

Part of #2938
